related.title: Atom Computing 陣列：隨機載入與滿載機率
related.titleEn: Atom Computing arrays: stochastic loading and full-occupancy probability
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付強度積分、焦點敏感度與極化率資料需求。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver intensity integration, focus sensitivity and polarizability-data requirements. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『Atom Computing 陣列：隨機載入與滿載機率』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付平均／滿載雙指標、對數核算與相關性測試設計。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Atom Computing arrays: stochastic loading and full-occupancy probability', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver mean/full-occupancy metrics, log verification and correlation tests.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：Gaussian峰值強度I0=2P/(πw²)，w為1/e²強度半徑；勢阱深度還需要極化率與失諧。 使用教學單鑷P=1 mW、w=1 μm；強度以MW/m²表示，不作雷射操作設定。 以手算或試算表計算名義式2*0.001/(pi*(1e-6)**2)/1e6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：對Gaussian截面積分應還原1 mW；若漏掉係數2，總功率將錯一倍。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：獨立載入、每格成功p時N格滿載概率P=p^N；平均Np與滿載概率是不同量。 使用教學N=20、單格p=0.5；不含重排、重試或相關載入。 以手算或試算表計算名義式0.5**20，另開一欄執行獨立核對：以log(P)=Nlog(p)交叉檢查；再列N=1極限，避免把0.9誤報成全陣列成功率。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Gaussian peak intensity I0=2P/(πw²) uses1/e² intensity radius w; trap depth also requires polarizability and detuning. Use Teaching single-tweezer P=1 mW and w=1 μm; express intensity in MW/m², not as a laser operating prescription. Evaluate nominal expression 2*0.001/(pi*(1e-6)**2)/1e6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Integrate the Gaussian profile to recover1 mW; omitting factor2 gives a factor-of-two power error.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: With independent per-site loading p, full occupancy of N sites is P=p^N; mean Np is a different quantity. Use Teaching N=20 and p=0.5 per site; exclude rearrangement, retries and correlated loading. Evaluate nominal expression 0.5**20 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Cross-check log(P)=Nlog(p) and the N=1 limit; do not report0.9 as array-level success.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 把單次元件效率轉成整條光路的保留率，分開條件保真度與無條件成功率。
related.differenceEn: Convert component efficiency into full-path survival and separate conditional fidelity from unconditional success.

practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：Gaussian峰值強度I0=2P/(πw²)，w為1/e²強度半徑；勢阱深度還需要極化率與失諧。 使用教學單鑷P=1 mW、w=1 μm；強度以MW/m²表示，不作雷射操作設定。 以手算或試算表計算名義式2*0.001/(pi*(1e-6)**2)/1e6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：對Gaussian截面積分應還原1 mW；若漏掉係數2，總功率將錯一倍。

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。光源耦合0.8，三圈迴路每圈0.95，偵測效率0.9，每批10000次。 η總=η源 η圈³ η偵測；期望計數=Nη總。 代入 10000*0.8*0.95**3*0.9，得到 6173.1 counts。獨立無記憶損耗相乘；若有模式依賴或時間相關損耗，單一平均效率不足。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Gaussian peak intensity I0=2P/(πw²) uses1/e² intensity radius w; trap depth also requires polarizability and detuning. Use Teaching single-tweezer P=1 mW and w=1 μm; express intensity in MW/m², not as a laser operating prescription. Evaluate nominal expression 2*0.001/(pi*(1e-6)**2)/1e6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Integrate the Gaussian profile to recover1 mW; omitting factor2 gives a factor-of-two power error.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Source coupling is 0.8, three loops each transmit 0.95, detection is 0.9, and a batch has 10000 trials. Total η=ηsource ηloop³ ηdetector; expected counts=Nη. Substituting 10000*0.8*0.95**3*0.9 gives 6173.1 counts. Independent memoryless transmissions multiply; mode-dependent or correlated loss invalidates one averaged efficiency. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
